name: reel-automator-resolve-plugin
description: DaVinci Resolve Workflow Integration panel for Reels Automator (S-09). Embeds the shared src/ frontend and drives the Resolve scripting API.
_packaging: A Resolve WI plugin is a PLAIN FOLDER Resolve hosts (HTML/JS + the native WorkflowIntegration.node + this Node backend) — NOT a standalone Electron app; Resolve provides the runtime. There is no electron-builder step. Install with `sidecar/install-resolve-plugin.sh`, which builds the renderer (`npm run build:resolve`), rsyncs the plugin folder into Resolve's WI plugins dir, and links the sidecars via a `binaries` symlink. Phase 6 (Developer ID signing + notarization) is descoped for personal/cross-device use — see resolve-plugin/README.md and the plan's Phase 6 note.
